messages.subject: Editor in RStudio 0.99 not working properly
parts:
I've installed RStudio on Kubuntu 14.04 ( used daily for 18 months )

All seemed ok yesterday - but today the RStudio editor is just not tracking mouse movements.  Placing the cursor to the right of a word/token - then press backspace and it deletes characters 8 spaces away - no consistency ... just renders it USELESS

I have been a programmer for 15 years C++ and 10 years with R and S+. Never seen this before - any suggestion on how to cure this appreciated ( never had this on RStudio 0.98 ).

JMG
